# Configuration reference

Every run setting, as used in run config files (YAML or JSON) and as `cba run` options. In config files use the key as written below. On the command line, write it with dashes, for example `sample_size` becomes `--sample-size`. True/false settings take `--name` or `--no-name` on the command line.

Settings are combined in this order, later sources win: built-in defaults, config files (in the order given with `-c`), options given on the command line. Unknown keys are an error. Relative paths are resolved from the folder you run `cba` in.

## What to run

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `run_id` | text | **required** | Name of the run. Output file: `<output_dir>`/`<run_id>`.jsonl |
| `codebook` | path | **required** | Codebook YAML path |
| `codebook_id` | text or empty | empty | Recorded codebook id (default: codebook 'id' or file stem) |
| `codebook_version` | text or empty | empty | Recorded codebook version (default: codebook 'version' or '1.0') |
| `dataset` | path | **required** | Input items (.jsonl/.json/.csv/.tsv/.xlsx) |
| `dataset_sheet` | text or empty | empty | Sheet name for .xlsx input |
| `dataset_name` | text or empty | empty | Recorded dataset name (default: dataset file stem) |
| `dataset_revision` | text or empty | empty | Recorded dataset revision/version (free text) |

## Fields and sampling

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id_field` | text | `item_id` | Field holding the item id in the dataset |
| `text_field` | text | `text` | Field holding the text to annotate |
| `split_field` | text or empty | `split` | Field used by split_value |
| `split_value` | text or empty | empty | Keep only records with split_field == split_value |
| `sample_size` | integer or empty | empty | Number of items (default: all) |
| `sampling` | one of: `first_n_by_id`, `random` | `first_n_by_id` | How sample_size items are chosen: the first N in id order, or N at random |
| `sampling_seed` | integer | `42` | Random seed for sampling: random |
| `sample_id` | text or empty | empty | Recorded sample id (default: derived from the sample contents) |

## Model

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `provider` | one of: `ollama`, `mistral_api`, `claude_api`, `openai_compatible`, `stub`, `replay` | **required** | Model provider |
| `model_tag` | text | **required** | Model name as the provider knows it (e.g. llama3.1:8b) |
| `model_digest` | text or empty | empty | Recorded model digest. 'auto' reads it from Ollama |
| `api_base` | text or empty | empty | Base URL of the API. Required for openai_compatible, optional for the other API providers |
| `api_key_env` | text or empty | empty | Environment variable holding the API key |
| `ollama_host` | text or empty | empty | Ollama server address (default: the OLLAMA_HOST variable, else http://localhost:11434) |
| `num_ctx` | integer | `65536` | Context window in tokens. Sent to Ollama only, recorded for every run |
| `temperature` | number | `0.0` | Sampling temperature |
| `seed` | integer or empty | empty | Generation seed, sent to providers that support one |
| `max_tokens` | integer or empty | empty | Maximum response length in tokens (claude_api uses 1024 when not set, ollama ignores it) |
| `json_mode` | true/false | `true` | openai_compatible only: request response_format json_object |
| `timeout` | number | `300.0` | Timeout per request, in seconds |
| `max_retries` | integer | `5` | Attempts per item for API providers, with growing waits in between. Ollama makes one attempt |
| `replay_from` | path or empty | empty | provider 'replay': earlier run file with raw_response |

## Prompt and optional features (all off by default)

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `prompt_template` | text | `default_v1` | Built-in template name, or the path of a template YAML file |
| `few_shot` | true/false | `false` | Show the codebook's examples in the prompt |
| `evidence` | true/false | `false` | Ask for verbatim quotes that support each present category |
| `evidence_policy` | one of: `report`, `enforce` | `report` | report: only record quote checks. enforce: set a category absent if no quote is verified |
| `verify` | true/false | `false` | Ask the model to check and correct its first answer in a second call |

## Execution and output

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `output_dir` | path | `runs` | Folder for the run file |
| `concurrency` | integer | `1` | Number of items sent to the model at the same time |
| `store_text` | true/false | `true` | Write the item text into each record |
| `store_raw_response` | true/false | `true` | Write the full model answer into each record |
| `strict_digest` | true/false | `true` | Stop if the observed Ollama digest differs from model_digest |
| `force_resume` | true/false | `false` | Resume even if the existing file came from a different config |
